start: Linked to a gym that has saved its opening hours; Gym tab open

user_sees: A clock row whose title is the open status, e.g. 'Open now · closes 10:00 pm', and under it 'Today <hours>'
must_not: No row, or a status worked out in the phone's own time zone instead of India time

user_sees: Screen 'Gym timings': the open status, '<gym name> · India time', the gym's note if any, and a 'This week' card with today highlighted
must_not: A blank screen or another gym's hours

user_sees: The spinner, then the newest hours from the gym
must_not: Old hours kept after the gym changed them, or a second copy of the list

start: Gym has a holiday or special day within the next 7 days

user_sees: The clock row's second line names the special day by itself (the holiday notice), not today's hours
must_not: The holiday hidden until the day itself, or shown for a day more than 7 days away

user_sees: 'Gym timings' with the special day marked in 'This week'
must_not: The normal hours shown for the holiday
